source: Ed4 C.4.7.3, pp.C-38 to C-39; C.7.3.2.1 Tests 1 and 2, pp.C-102 to C-104
description: The peer repeats its RESET RX WIN CMND with the same RESET FRAME ID after this node's RESET ACK went: the copy is acknowledged again and not acted on again, and the data that follows it in the same transmission is delivered as before.
note: As dts-arq/rx-win-cmnd-sets-rx-lwe up to 151550: the peer's RESET RX WIN CMND (RESET FRAME ID 3, NEW RECEIVE LWE 5) set RX LWE to 5 and the RESET ACK went at 146000. The peer has not heard that RESET ACK, so at 156000 it repeats the same command, same RESET FRAME ID 3 (C-0255, C-1172), EOT 20, followed in the same burst by its DATA-ONLY FSN 5 'pong' with TX WIN UWE and LWE (2 blocks, EOT 20). The RESET FRAME ID equals the last one received, so the command is a copy (C-0271, C-1173): it is acknowledged again (C-0266) and not acted on again; RX LWE stays 5. FSN 5 then passes Tests 1 and 2 (arcs 4 to 32772 and 32773 to 5) and is delivered. The state stays DATA(CONNECTED) (C-0681). At 202000 one transmission carries the RESET ACK (RESET ACK 1, every other field 0, EOT 20), the ACK-ONLY with RX LWE 6 (EOT 20) and, in the 20 bytes left of the second block, a copy of the ACK-ONLY (15 bytes, EOT 10, C-0882, C-1154); RESET/WIN-RESYNC control D_PDUs go ahead of the ACK-ONLY (C-1174). Fixture: preamble 600, flush 150, 25 bytes and 4800 ms a block, so an n-block transmission lasts 750 + 4800 n ms, and the EOT of a D_PDU starting in block b of n is ceil((4800 (n - b) + 150) / 500): 10, 20, 30 for 1, 2, 3 blocks to go (C-0104, C-1043). Addresses 0.0.1.2 (this node) and 0.0.1.3 take address size 3 (C-0133), so a DATA-ONLY is 19 bytes plus its segment, a DATA-ACK 22 bytes plus bitmap and segment, an ACK-ONLY 15 bytes plus its bitmap, a RESET/WIN-RESYNC (type 12) 15 bytes, an EXPEDITED-DATA-ONLY 18 bytes plus its segment, an EXPEDITED-ACK-ONLY 12 bytes plus its bitmap, a WARNING 12 and a PADDING 11. Seed 0 draws uniform(16) = 15, 4, 15, 12, 11, 10, 1, 12: contention waits 45000, 12000, 45000, 36000, 33000, 30000, 3000, 36000 ms (K-0080). The peer is recorded Ed4, so spare room in a last block takes an ACK-ONLY copy or a PADDING D_PDU when one fits (C-0367, C-1154). The SIS soft link times are unset, so they are derived: sis.soft_link_idle and sis.soft_link_min_hold (called node only) three answer waits, sis.soft_link_max six; none falls due within the run, and the idle wait stops while an ARQ U_PDU is outstanding (A-0320, A-0321, A-0326).
